answer: A decaying work-credential reputation keeps Sybil identities expensive: each identity earns non-transferable credentials only by verified, useful work — reviewing code, attesting transactions, tending shared data — and each credential is bound to one identity and weathers like shale unless renewed by fresh work. Privileges grow only as a living garden of recent credentials accumulates; credentials cannot be bought, transferred, or copied. A farmer wanting ten thousand puppets must sustain ten thousand streams of ongoing work, because idle puppets fade to cold marble and lose all standing.
